flows.name: Sunset / Re-permission (tiered, reconciled)

steps.name: Wave A (engaged_365, soft): a quick check-in — still want to hear from us?
Wave B (unengaged_12m, ask 1): do you still want these emails?
Wave B (unengaged_12m, ask 2 / final): last call before we stop mailing you

flows.note: Reconciles the flow that sat disabled since 2026-01-12. Wave A (engaged_365) gets a single soft nudge with no suppression threat, sent 2026-09-01. Wave B (unengaged_12m) gets the two-touch re-permission ask starting 2026-09-15, final ask 2026-09-25; non-responders are suppressed. Every wave completes by 2026-10-27, three weeks ahead of the 2026-11-20 BFCM start. No wave runs during the BFCM window or its ramp.
